newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 14.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Henri Konan Bedie in Rone today to participate in ceremonies for the U.N. Food and Agriculture Organisations's World Food Day on Wednesday.
- Prime minister Daniel Kablan Duncan returns home after two weeks of canvassing investors in the United States and Canada, declaring his mission fruitful.
- Ivory Coast's commodity marketing board CAISTAB, in advertisment, invites cocoa buying agents to complete documentation before October 22 for their purchase licenses for 1996/97 cocoa campaign.
- Opposition Ivorian Popular Front party says in statement government and educational institutions ill prepared for start of academic year, which begins officially on Tuesday.
- Delegation from French city of Rouen visits Abidjan as part of an Africa mission to promote its port facilities.
